summary: All auth/dashboard requirements are implemented and verified: tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors, npm run build succeeds (1948 modules), ProtectedRoute guards /dashboard, Navbar shows authenticated dropdown, Dashboard has welcome header + 3 stat cards + bookings/equipment tabs with Approve/Reject, and localStorage persistence is in place.
findings: intendedPath stored in React state only — lost on hard refresh or new-tab navigation while unauthenticated; acceptable for mock auth but a real implementation should use sessionStorage or a ?next= URL param.
